findings.title: Error timestamps likely compared against replay event timestamps in different units
findings.body: gen_request_data compares `error_events[idx]["timestamp"]` (nodestore event timestamp, float seconds) with `event.get("timestamp", 0)` from rrweb segment events, which are normally epoch milliseconds. If the units differ, every error is less than every replay event, so all errors are emitted before the first breadcrumb. The chronological interleaving then fails and the 'at <timestamp>' values mix seconds and milliseconds in the prompt sent to Seer. The tests only pass because they use identical small or second-based values. Normalize one side (for example multiply the error timestamp by 1000) before comparing.

findings.title: Error ids zipped with nodestore results by position
findings.body: `zip(error_ids, events.values())` assumes `nodestore.backend.get_multi` returns values in the same order as the requested ids, and that no ids are missing. `get_multi` returns a dict keyed by node id. Missing nodes or a different ordering misattribute event ids to the wrong data. Iterate the node ids and look up each one in the dict instead.

findings.title: Analytics event recorded before the feature-flag check
findings.body: `analytics.record("preprod_artifact.api.assemble", ...)` runs before the `organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble` check. Requests from organizations without the feature, which get a 404, are still counted as assemble events. This inflates the metric. Record after the feature gate.

findings.title: Truthiness check on age/timestamp lets age=0 coexist with timestamp
findings.body: validate_timestamp and validate_age use `self.initial_data.get("age")` and `.get("timestamp")` as truthiness checks. `age: 0` is a valid value in the Editor's Draft format. A report with `age: 0` plus a `timestamp` passes validation even though the two specs are meant to be mutually exclusive. Use `"age" in self.initial_data` instead.

findings.title: Flagged TableWidgetVisualization is rendered with empty columns and empty data
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, the widget renders `TableWidgetVisualization` with `columns={[]}` and an empty `tableData`. The real `result.data` and `result.meta` are ignored, and `columns={[]}` also defeats the fallback to `meta.fields`. Every table widget in an org with the flag on therefore shows an empty table. This is only safe while the flag is off, and the placeholder should be wired to the result data or clearly marked as a TODO.

findings.title: Hook now returns undefined attributes and drops the environment filter
findings.body: The old hook always returned a `TagCollection` (an empty object while loading). It now returns `isFetching ? previous : data`, which is `undefined` until the first fetch resolves, so callers that index or iterate `attributes` can break. The `environment` query param (selection.environments) is also no longer sent, and the `staleTime: 0`, `refetchOnWindowFocus: false` and `retry: false` options were dropped. That changes caching and refetch behavior. Default `attributes` to `{}` and confirm the dropped options are intentional.
